# TruffleHog exclude paths (one regex per line).
# Example configuration files and development seeds hold no real credentials.
# When adding a line here, say in one comment why it is not a real secret.

# Local development placeholders only.
^apps/[^/]+/\.env\.example$
# Development account seed - the password equals the nickname, dev database only.
^apps/api/src/db/seed\.ts$
# The dev compose file uses local-only credentials (coblocks/coblocks).
^docker/docker-compose\.dev\.yaml$
